title: Servers · Usage accounting
description: Who used how much, over any time range

list.name: step
list.description: collector interval in seconds (must match config.toml)

panels.title: GPU compute-hours
panels.description: SM-utilisation-weighted: 1 h of one GPU at 100% = 1 GPU-hour.

panels.title: Usage by user (all selected servers)
panels.description: Integrals over the time range. GiB-h = GiB held × hours. idle VRAM % = share of the user's VRAM-hours spent with the holding job GPU-idle.

panels.title: Over time (bucketed; bucket size follows the zoom level, min 1h)
Workload × user
panels.description: Only jobs above the export threshold are counted here, so totals are slightly below the per-user numbers.

panels.title: Top jobs / programs in the period

targets.expr: (sum by(host,user,pid,kind,cmd,container) (sum_over_time(servmon_job_gpu_sm_percent{host=~"$host",user=~"$user",kind=~"$kind"}[$__range])) * $step / 3600 / 100) and on(host,user,pid,kind,cmd,container) topk(40, sum by(host,user,pid,kind,cmd,container) (sum_over_time(servmon_job_gpu_sm_percent{host=~"$host",user=~"$user",kind=~"$kind"}[$__range])) * $step / 3600 / 100)
